title: Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness Fund Seeks Capital for $40B Fluidstack Investment
summary:
The investment firm led by Leopold Aschenbrenner is raising money from clients to increase its ownership in AI infrastructure provider Fluidstack. The current fundraising effort for the cloud company, which supplies computing capacity to artificial intelligence labs, would value the business at $40B.

The move expands Aschenbrenner's stake in the data center operator following a $7.5B funding round he led in January. Fluidstack has also received backing from BlackRock and Gavin Baker's Atreides.
